text:
Good news for calmer arrivals: our Companion Animal Travel Desk updates are ready for your day. 

A warm reminder from Aurelia Skyways staff and travelers alike: For Thornwick, the quarantine room has 26 kennels, and the senior coordinator and welfare coordinator keep comfort checks steady from intake to onward movement. Our guides work closely with trained teams to channel every companion animal through clear, kind steps, with patient attention and straightforward guidance that helps families feel prepared. If you are traveling, follow the concise instructions provided at check-in, so your companion enjoys a smooth, respectful transition. Please share this with your team and plan with care as you go.
